measured_cause.cdp_private: navigator.windowControlsOverlay.getTitlebarAreaRect(): Arabic x=64 width=1026 (overlay drawn left), Arabic+LTR x=0 width=1026 (overlay drawn right); env(titlebar-area-x/width) equal; document dir=rtl lang=ar in both
measured_cause.inference: Electron reports the overlay consistently. The page reserves the titlebar area on the inline side (right in RTL) from the physical env x value, so in an RTL document its reserved gap is always opposite the drawn buttons. Without the switch the buttons sit over its drag region (drag wins: press = move); with it they sit over its own sidebar/back/forward icons. The VS Code control below shows a caption button over non-drag content still works.
measured_cause.upstream: app defect in the vendor page; MoOS cannot patch the signed vendor bytes. No exact upstream report found.
